summary: Space Exploration Technologies Corp. (SpaceX) filed an 8-K announcing the pricing of a multi-tranche senior unsecured notes offering totaling $25.0 billion, with tranches ranging from 5.350% senior notes due 2031 to 6.650% senior notes due 2056. The offering is expected to settle on June 26, 2026. Proceeds will be used to repay the company's bridge loan facility in full, pay related fees and expenses, and for general corporate purposes. The offering was not registered under the Securities Act. As a debt financing event rather than a special situation like an acquisition or restructuring, this is classified as 'Other'.
